notes: Source masters live in /_source and are not shipped. /public/assets holds delivery copies only.
All delivered video is 1920x1080 H.264 yuv420p, faststart, silent unless stated.
Source clips were 1276x720 and are upscaled with lanczos to the 1920x1080 stage.
Plates named P01-P08 are DRV freeze frames taken from the delivered videos, so the video->plate switch in the media engine is pixel-exact.
